_about: Real, published UPI aggregates used as calibration targets for sim_v1. tier=official: NPCI data (direct or via dataful.in mirror of NPCI); tier=secondary: government release quoted by a secondary source (PIB page blocks automated fetch).

p2p_p2m.source: NPCI UPI Ecosystem Statistics, P2P and P2M, via https://dataful.in/datasets/431/

p2m_share_below_500.source: PIB, Ministry of Finance, 'UPI completes 10 years' (PRID 2257087), quoted via web search

bank_volume_share.source: data/external/reference_datasets/npci/Ecosystem-Statistics-UPI-Chargeback-2026-Sep.xlsx (beneficiary bank, total txns during the month); computed by data/eval/datasets/references.py npci_bank_shares()
